claims: The 2026 NFL Draft takes place from Thursday, April 23, through Saturday, April 25, 2026, in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
The first round of the 2026 NFL Draft kicks off at 8 p.m. ET on Thursday.
Coverage of the 2026 NFL Draft is available on ABC, ESPN, and NFL Network.
Round 1 of the 2026 NFL Draft is on Thursday, April 23, at 8 p.m. ET.
Rounds 2-3 of the 2026 NFL Draft are on Friday, April 24, at 7 p.m. ET.
Rounds 4-7 of the 2026 NFL Draft are on Saturday, April 25, at Noon ET.
TV channels for the 2026 NFL Draft are ESPN, ABC, NFL Network, ESPN Deportes, and ESPN Radio.
Streaming options for the 2026 NFL Draft are NFL+, Disney+, and Hulu.
The 2026 NFL Draft is held on the North Shore of Pittsburgh.
The 2026 NFL Draft is held near Acrisure Stadium.
The 2026 NFL Draft can be attended for free by registering on the NFL OnePass App.
